items.baseline_problem: The V1 value panel had held-out standard deviations below 2e-7, insufficient to identify a useful hard-value response.
closure_criteria: Pass the frozen PILOT_PROTOCOL actuator gate: every seed has original-plus-candidate endpoint response-value range at least 0.005 and the selected candidate changes at least 5% of response-panel semantic/image decisions.
Pass the frozen ordinary pilot gate: select only candidates with nonnegative development gain and clean-development change >= -0.01 in every seed; selected pooled development gain must be >=0.005.

Before a new primary test, also pass the separate frozen-trajectory response gate: each seed has mean within-snapshot action spread >=0.001 and at least25% of snapshots with spread>=0.001. Do not apply an extra0.005 threshold to each branch snapshot.

Keep deterministic no-update controls, output-component changes, effective-operator movement, paired RNG and complete optimizer state. No-update branch hard value must equal current value within1e-12.
items.resolution: All 18 pilot candidates complete; selected upstream rank8/288-step actuator passes the original hard-response and development gates in every seed. Frozen H7 within-snapshot action spread and zero-control/state tests also pass. Scope is this actuator and panel, not universal controllability.

v3_update.resolution: V3 retains the same upstream rank8 actuator; complete development includes observable ordinary gains and253440 byte-verified actual outputs. No universal controllability claim.

Compare delta-value prediction with no-change/last-value, fitting-set mean-delta and action-conditioned mean-delta baselines. Compare decision regret with the strongest fixed action chosen without audit labels.
Report complete-trajectory-cluster paired uncertainty and results by original model seed; sequential rows are not independent units.
A new audit used for refitting or model selection becomes development evidence and requires a subsequent untouched audit.

Apply the frozen exact G3/G4 thresholds in gate_audit.py: pooled MSE<=0.9*best predetermined baseline with no seed worse; pooled regret<=0.8*fit-selected fixed regret; advantage>=0.001 and paired trajectory95% lower>0. Eight fit and eight audit trajectories per seed are required.
items.resolution: All nine predictors frozen before audit. Original H7 G3/G4 thresholds pass: MSE 0.0000300344 versus baseline 0.0000464601; regret ratio 0.6158; action advantage 0.00155466, trajectory 95% CI[0.00119183,0.00194834]. This establishes local eight-step skill on the shared response panel and new optimizer trajectories, not source-disjoint panel generalization or final policy superiority.

items.resolution: Original independent nine-comparison retention family and -0.01 margin preserved. Dual-observer noninferiority passes C,D,E,F,H,J (6/9); it is not established for B,G,K. These non-passes do not prove damage beyond the margin. No retention data was used to select or refit methods.
